summary: Sound Point Meridian Capital, Inc. filed an 8-K solely to announce its fourth fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2026 financial results via press release. The filing reports net asset value per share of $9.63, net investment income of $7.0 million ($0.34 per common share), and a GAAP net loss of $74.7 million ($3.63 per share). No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or other corporate transaction is disclosed. This is a routine earnings press release, not a triggering event for a special-situations category. No deal terms or strategic actions are present.
